The test image shows a corn ear (pod) with:
- Very dark brown/black mold at the tip
- Green-gray mold patch in the middle of the ear
- Otherwise yellow kernels
- Dry/bleached husks

This is a pod/ear with mold. Candidates: Aspergillus_Ear_Rot (olive-green at tip), Trichoderma_Ear_Rot (green-gray conidia), Penicillium_Ear_Rot (blue-green at tip).

The dark tip and green mold most suggest Aspergillus. Let me check a reference.

The reference Aspergillus image shows the characteristic olive-green to gray-green powdery mold on kernels — this matches very well with the green-gray mold patch visible in the test image. The dark/black tip in the test image is consistent with heavy Aspergillus infection that has progressed to a darker shade.
